_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. doctronic.ai's stylesheets declare a named token layer (@layer tokens): the colour ramps and the composite --text-* font tokens on :root, the semantic --color-* roles on :root for light and redeclared under [data-theme="dark"] for the site's real dark theme (localStorage.theme, applied to data-theme by an init script). Semantic declarations that are a plain var(--primitive) become {color.*} aliases; the hsl(from … / alpha) derivations stay var-referenced. The measured extras under core.measured and light.component.* come from raw/components-computed.json.
